content: <thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 193.1103, which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral mass of ≈192.103 Da. The formula that matches this exact mass best is C₈H₁₆O₅ (neutral mass 192.0998 Da, [M+H]+ = 193.1071 Da, within experimental error). The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈12 %) is consistent with a molecule containing eight carbons. No halogen or nitrogen is required. Therefore the molecular formula is C8H16O5.
